issues.description: Exact cluster counts for integrated, epithelial and immune subclusterings are not reported in the paper; null values are used in cluster_inventory for those entries.
No Schwann cells (L2) are described in this mammary gland study; all verified markers refer to non-Schwann cell types and are classified as 'outside' the four-layer PNS categories.

task.paper_title: Time-resolved single-cell analysis of Brca1 associated mammary tumourigenesis reveals aberrant differentiation of luminal progenitors.
